summary: Raw IPv4 bind updates inet socket source-address fields without holding the socket lock while datagram connect reads them under the normal connect path.

call_chain.evidence: raw_bind is the raw socket protocol bind callback and the KCSAN write site.
Repaired datagram.ll defines the socket connect wrapper.
KCSAN read stack points to this function.

bug_site.code: read of inet socket source-address state

interleaving: One task binds a raw socket and writes inet_rcv_saddr/inet_saddr without lock_sock().
Another task connects the same socket and reads the source address fields in __ip4_datagram_connect.
The fix wraps raw_bind in lock_sock()/release_sock() so the bind writes are serialized with connect.

access_b.code: source address read from inet_sk(sk) during connect

ground_truth_access.required_ordering: Bind and connect operations on the same socket must be serialized by the socket lock.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: These fields store the bound IPv4 source address for the socket and are shared between bind and connect operations.

aliases.name: inet->inet_rcv_saddr
aliases.evidence: inet is inet_sk(sk) and raw_bind writes the receive source address.

aliases.name: inet->inet_saddr
aliases.evidence: raw_bind writes the outgoing source address and may reset it for multicast/broadcast.

aliases.name: inet_sk(sk)->inet_saddr
aliases.evidence: The connect path reads inet socket source-address state.

thread_b.evidence: __ip4_datagram_connect operates on the same struct sock.

allocated_by: socket allocation creates struct sock with embedded struct inet_sock
published_by: socket file descriptor exposes bind/connect operations

coverage.analysis_conclusion: raw.c defines the writer callback and datagram.c defines the reported reader; higher syscall wrappers are candidate context.

patch_hunks: 153a0d187e76 adds lock_sock(sk) and release_sock(sk) around raw_bind.
indirect_edges: raw_bind is registered as the raw IPv4 bind callback.
repair_commands: Compiled datagram.c with clang-15 and linked raw.ll + datagram.ll with external llvm-link.
